Work IQ on/off — web-grounded vs. Work IQ–grounded chat

There's one chat box with a single Work IQ toggle — flip it to control what Copilot grounds its answer in. The example prompts are written for PHR work, in Bahasa Indonesia.

Copilot
ChatCowork
Message Copilot
+Auto ▾↑
Flip the Work IQ switchOne chat, one toggle — not two separate chats.
Work IQ off Copilot Chat (Basic)Premium

Web-grounded chat

Copilot answers from the web and the model's training data, plus the files you hand it — none of your Microsoft 365 data. Every prompt starts with you finding, attaching or pasting the material first.

  • Open-web knowledge
  • Plus any files you attach — and, in Outlook and Teams, the content you have open
  • Available to Basic & Premium
Work IQ on Microsoft Copilot (Premium)

Work IQ–grounded chat

On by default. Copilot also reasons over your work across Microsoft 365 — emails, chats, meetings and files — trimmed to what you already have permission to see. The context is there before you type.

  • Everything web-grounded chat does
  • Your emails, chats, meetings and files
  • Permission-trimmed — nothing you can't already open
Grounded inWeb (Bing)Files you attachOpen email / Teams content
Grounded inWeb (Bing)Files you attachMail & calendarTeams chats & meetingsSharePoint & OneDrive

Tanpa Work IQ ·HSSE · Well Service
Ringkas /SOP Permit to Work Rev.3.pdf menjadi 10 poin untuk safety briefing pagi kru well service, dengan bahasa yang mudah dipahami pekerja lapangan.
Tanpa Work IQ ·Production Engineer
Bandingkan /Laporan Produksi Harian 8 Nov.xlsx dengan /Laporan Produksi Harian 9 Nov.xlsx. Tampilkan 5 sumur dengan penurunan terbesar dan pertanyaan yang perlu saya ajukan ke tim lapangan.
Tanpa Work IQ ·Facility Engineer · web
Cari praktik terbaik global untuk mengurangi heat loss pada jaringan pipa injeksi uap di lapangan steamflood. Sertakan sumber dan buat ringkasan satu halaman.
Dengan Work IQ ·Production Superintendent
Siapkan bahan morning meeting saya besok: agenda dari undangan kalender, isu produksi dan HSSE yang dibahas di Teams hari ini, dan email penting yang belum saya balas.
Dengan Work IQ ·Workover Planner
Rangkum perkembangan program workover minggu ini dari email, chat Teams, dan notulen rapat — keputusan apa yang sudah diambil, siapa PIC-nya, dan apa yang masih tertunda?
Dengan Work IQ ·SCM · Contract Owner
Dari rapat dan email dengan [vendor jasa rig] bulan ini, apa saja tindak lanjut yang saya janjikan dan mana yang belum selesai?

Notice the pattern. Each prompt starts with you supplying the material — attaching a file with /, or asking the web. Copilot is capable, but it starts from zero every time.

The prompt gets shorter, and the question gets bigger. You stop describing the material and ask about your actual work — your meetings, mail, chats and files are already in context.

Work IQ is part of Microsoft IQ — the intelligence platform that also brings Fabric IQ (Power BI and Fabric data), Foundry IQ and Web IQ. For PHR, Fabric data in Microsoft Copilot is the path to Power BI production reports — see the Advanced with Data user on slide 5.

What is Cowork — and a one-click demo for PHR

Cowork is the agentic side of Microsoft Copilot: you describe an outcome, it plans and carries out the steps across your apps, and it asks before anything consequential.

Cowork Premium + Copilot Credits

Hand it an outcome, not a question — it plans the steps, works across your apps for as long as the job takes, and checks with you before anything leaves the building.

Reaches forYour Outlook, Teams, files and data — grounded in Work IQ, inside your own permissions
TradesA single reply for a finished outcome — minutes to hours, running on its own
Gives you backReal files in your OneDrive, a task you can reopen, and an approval gate before it sends
Access takes two things: a Microsoft Copilot license and a spending policy that selects Cowork — the policy is an access control, not just a budget. At PHR: the PHR Cowork Policy, billed to PHR's Azure subscription.
PHR use case · one-click demo

Three families of users: User, Creator, Admin

Every PHR employee who uses AI at work fits one of ten roles in three families — Users use AI, Creators build with it, Admins govern it.

Family 1 Use

User

Most of the PHR workforce — use AI to get their own work done.

  • 1BasicCopilot Chat (Basic) · no add-on license
  • 2IntermediateMicrosoft Copilot (Premium) · USL
  • 3AdvancedUSL + Copilot Credits · Cowork
  • 4Advanced with DataAdvanced + Power BI and Fabric data
Main tools
How it's paidIncluded → per-user license (USL) → + Copilot Credits per task
At PHR, for exampleField admin, HSSE officer, production and facility engineers, planners, finance analysts
▶
Family 2 Build

Creator

Build apps, agents and automations that other people use.

  • 5App CreatorCowork apps, Copilot Code (Frontier)
  • 6Agent CreatorAgent Builder, Copilot Studio
  • 7Automation DeveloperPower Automate, Power Apps
  • 8Pro-Code DeveloperAzure AI Foundry, Work IQ APIs
Main toolsAgent BuilderPower PlatformAzure AI Foundry
How it's paidThe harness decides: included (fair use) or Copilot Credits; Power Platform licenses; Azure consumption
At PHR, for exampleA process owner builds a Permit-to-Work Q&A agent; the Digital team hardens a workover tracker app
▶
Family 3 Govern

Admin

Accountable for agents in production and for the budget.

  • 9Agent ManagerOwns specific agents and their budget
  • 10AI Platform ManagerPolicies, billing and governance
Main toolsMicrosoft 365 admin centerCost managementAgent 365
How it's paidAgent 365 per user for agent managers; admin roles; owns the Copilot Credit pool and showback
At PHR, for exampleThe PHR Copilot focal point (IT / Digital) owns PHR's groups, receives alerts and re-tiers users quarterly — tenant admin roles stay with Persero
Core rule — tier on validated work, never seniorityA senior manager who only uses chat is a Basic user; an engineer who runs weekly Cowork tasks is an Advanced user.
Where cost beginsBetween Intermediate and Advanced. Cowork is billed in Copilot Credits from one tenant-wide pool, so this boundary needs the most care.
Families become groupsEach family maps to PHR security groups, and each group to exactly one admin control — see slide 6.
Sources · Microsoft Copilot — Summary, Section 2 User profiling example (planning guidance, not Microsoft requirements) · USL and usage-based billing · Harnesses in Copilot Studio · Manage Copilot Cowork — Microsoft Learn

Four types of User: Basic, Intermediate, Advanced, Advanced with Data

Each step up the ladder adds capability and cost. Place people by the work they have actually done and had checked.

Each step adds one PHR group (slide 6)
Basic · no group→LSG-PHR-Copilot-Premium→PSG-PHR-Copilot-Cowork→DSG-PHR-Copilot-Data
1
Type 1

Basic

Copilot Chat (Basic)

Who: new or occasional AI users — the starting point for every PHR employee on an eligible Microsoft 365 plan.

  • Rewrite a memo or safety bulletin
  • Summarize an uploaded SOP
  • Web research on a technical topic
  • Approved agents from the store
Move up when they use AI on most working days and have a written use case that needs their own work data.
2
Type 2

Intermediate

Microsoft Copilot (Premium) · USL

Who: knowledge workers whose work lives in email, meetings, Teams and Office documents.

  • Morning-meeting recap from Teams
  • Inbox catch-up and drafted replies
  • Excel analysis of a daily production report
  • A deck from a report; deep research with Researcher
Move up when they have repeatable multi-step workflows with a measurable time saving.
3
Type 3

Advanced

USL+ Copilot Credits · Cowork

Who: people who hand off whole multi-step outcomes rather than single prompts.

  • Weekly production & workover review delegated to Cowork (slide 3)
  • Recurring report packs
  • Preparation for management meetings
Needs to be in a spending policy that selects Cowork — per-user limit of at least 2,000 credits a month.
4
Type 4

Advanced with Data

Advanced+ Power BI & Fabric data

Who: production surveillance, reliability, planning and finance users whose work starts from Power BI reports.

  • Ask Copilot about a Power BI production report
  • Turn a KPI trend into a review meeting
  • Summarize a report and email stakeholders
  • Recurring executive summaries
Needs Fabric data in Microsoft Copilot scoped to their group, plus Read access to the reports. Copilot reads within their own permissions, including row-level security.
IncludedEligible Microsoft 365 subscription · no add-on
Fixed per user per monthMicrosoft Copilot license (USL)
USL + Copilot Credits per taskUsage-based billing (UBB)
USL + Copilot Credits per taskNo extra Fabric capacity for the Fabric IQ plugin

Security groups and policies PHR should have

One Microsoft Entra ID security group per control. PHR owns the membership; the Persero tenant admin points each license, policy or setting at the group once.

Positioning PHR groups against the Persero groups in the ptptmn tenant

PHR's groups are entity groups inside the one Pertamina tenant: group-wide settings stay with Persero; licenses, Cowork billing and data access are scoped to PHR.

TopicPersero (ptptmn) group / settingPHR groupHow they relate · who acts
1LicenseLSG-HLD-Copilot-PremiumLSG-PHR-Copilot-PremiumSame license, separate group per entity, so PHR's count stays visible. Persero assigns the license to the group; PHR's owners manage members.
2Cowork & billingDefault policy · PSG-HLD-Copilot-CoworkPSG-PHR-Copilot-CoworkSeparate PHR Cowork Policy billed to PHR. When policies overlap, the highest per-user limit wins — Persero scopes its default policy to its own groups or removes Cowork from it.
3Power BI dataFabric data in Microsoft CopilotDSG-PHR-Copilot-DataPHR's group is added under Specific groups; PHR keeps its workspace roles, row-level security and sensitivity labels.
4FrontierFSG-GRP-Copilot-FrontierPHR pilots · App CreatorsFrontier access is set once for the tenant, so PHR pilots join the group-wide group as direct members.
5Copilot StudioSSG-GRP-CopilotStudio-AuthorsSSG-PHR-Agent-AuthorsPHR authors are direct members of the group-wide authors group, and makers only in PHR environments.
6Admin & reportsRSG-GRP-Copilot-Admins / -ReadersRSG-PHR-Copilot-OwnersPHR holds no tenant admin role. Persero shares consumption reports and alerts; credit requests go to Persero unless a custom request policy is agreed.
Agree the overlap rule with PerseroAn all-users policy that selects Cowork grants Cowork to everyone and can bill PHR users to Persero. Precedence: highest per-user limit, then largest policy limit, then most recent.
Illustrative namesPersero names follow the Pertamina group design example (5 Nov 2026) — confirm the actual groups in ptptmn with Persero.
